notes:
Founder-led conversation, very scrappy early-stage (seed). Founder = Jonah Park (ex-devtools engineer). Primary ask: clear, comparable pricing vs OpenAI/Anthropic and how Redwood keeps cost down (batching, caching). Quote: "We like the idea of a simpler per-token bill but need a realistic estimate for a 5k monthly active users MVP."

Call notes (short bullets):
- Uses models for in-app coding assistant + chat guidance + semantic search over docs. Low concurrency today (10-50 reqs/min), hopeful to scale quickly if UX sticks.
- Latency expectation: <300ms p50 for short-turn chat; p95 ok up to 700ms.
- Cost sensitivity: high — founder repeatedly asked about per-1k-token and tail costs, prefers predictable unit economics over opaque bursts.
- Model preferences: currently testing OpenAI GPT-4o & Anthropic Claude 2; interested in open variants if price/latency tradeoffs are compelling.
- Security: wants SSO/SAML roadmapped; needs audit logs for next funding conversations but not blocking MVP.
- Legal: asked if Redwood terms allow commercial data usage and basic indemnities; referred to drive/legal/redwood-smb-terms (sent).
- Technical: small test dataset (~200 docs) for semantic search; asked about embeddings endpoint stability and cost per embedding.
- Quote on competition: "We'd switch from OpenAI if it's cheaper + similar latency and easy SDKs."

Action items captured: send concise 1-pager pricing comparison, provide token-cost calculator for their workload, offer 2-week extra trial credits tied to the sandbox tokens, loop in SE (Daniel) for latency benchmarking notes.
use_case_summary: MVP: in-app coding/chat assistant and doc search. Workload: short chat turns (50-150 tokens), few long code completions. Targets: p50 latency <300ms, throughput currently low (10-50 reqs/min), cost-sensitive; prefer hosted_api with predictable per-token pricing and simple SDKs.
pitch_feedback: Likes SDK ergonomics, wants example pricing for 1M tokens/month and 10k embeddings/month. Concerned about hidden egress/overage fees.
notes_short: Early-stage SMB, founder-led. Main blocker: pricing clarity + benchmark vs OpenAI/Anthropic. Next: pricing email + follow-up demo.
